messages:
elena: Quick merge window for docs PR #3987 — updates the Rust SDK snippet and a small migration note. Plan to merge today 11:30am PT. Need 2 approvals + a green docs preview.

sam: who do you want as reviewers?

elena: @mike and @nora if you're available. Mike can you sanity-check the Rust snippet vs latest SDK changes?

mike: will do a quick pass. Also FYI netlify preview currently 404s for /assets/fonts/ — local preview is fine though.

nora: I saw that. Logs show a 403 during artifact upload, likely a transient S3 ACL issue. Retrying a rebuild now.

Doc-builder-bot: build queued for PR #3987 — https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/preview-3987

doc-builder-bot: build failed (artifact upload) — https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/preview-3987/logs (snippet: `Error: EACCES: permission denied, open /tmp/deploy-assets/fonts.zip`)

sam: If the preview is just fonts falling back to system, do we still block the merge? Might be acceptable if fallback is graceful.

elena: prefer to fix but don't want to stall the release window. Plan: wait 20m for @nora to retry. If still failing, we add a short changelog note about font fallback and merge at 11:50. We'll do a staggered merge (merge the docs-only PR, monitor console for any rendering issues).

nora: triggered rebuild — new deploy at https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/ba7f1 (sha: 7a1b2c). Running local reproduce: `mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000` and `python -m http.server 9000 --directory site` to check asset paths.

mike: lgtm from code side, Rust snippet matches current crate API. Approving now.

sam: approved. Quick note: when merging, use squash and fill the release notes: "docs: update Rust SDK snippet + migration tip".

elena: merging now. Reminder to use the PR template checkbox for "docs preview green" — if failing for infra reasons, add a note and ping #eng-infra. Also ping #eng-oncall if any client errors spike after merge. :rocket:

Doc-builder-bot: deploy started to preview -> prod (kick off prod job)

doc-builder-bot: deploy successful — preview (sha 7a1b2c) available: https://deploy-preview-3987--redwood-docs.netlify.app

elena: Post-merge checklist: 1) watch console errors for 15m, 2) update changelog on release branch, 3) drop note in #release-war-room if anything unexpected.

doc-builder-bot: prod deploy complete — https://docs.redwood.ai/ (sha 7a1b2c)
